entities.summary: Boris Sergeyevich Mirkin-Getzevich, also known by his pen name, Boris Mirsky, was a Russian jurist. He had been a director of the Paris Institute of Comparative Law and a professor at the Institute of Higher International Studies, Faculty of Law of Paris.
